limitations: Local loopback, headless Chromium, one Windows 11 host
Cold readiness includes a fixed 300 ms settle after a 50-item API page and visible last row
Scroll is a synthetic 2400 ms full-range requestAnimationFrame sweep over 150 loaded messages, not user-perceived display FPS
Memory is forced-GC renderer JavaScript heap and DOM counters; process RSS/GPU memory are not measured
SES2000 is a synthetic worst-case growth scenario, not a typical real session
Retention uses handle-free locators and forced GC; heap warming is not by itself proof of a product leak
